references.text: Basic instructions regarding the peace offering (שְׁלָמִים), providing context for how the offering is to be presented to the Lord.
Additional laws concerning the peace offering, describing the various types of peace offerings and how they are to be handled.
Refers to a person bringing a peace offering (זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים) to the Lord, with the requirement that the offering must be without defect.
Instructions on bringing an offering to the place the Lord chooses, including the peace offering.
General instruction to bring one's offering (קָרְבָּן) before the Lord; the same terminology is used here.
Continuation of the text describing what the person making the offering must bring with their own hands to the Lord.
